recommendation.title: Recommended next step
rec.noAds.headline: Focus on creative and site readiness first
rec.noAds.reason: Without paid campaigns, strong videos and a clear landing experience do the heavy lifting on your organic channels.
rec.noAds.tradeoff: Organic reach grows more slowly and there's no paid-reach estimate to plan against.
rec.automotive.headline: Lead with visual proof and a controlled message campaign
rec.automotive.reason: Car buyers and service customers in Qatar respond to seeing the real vehicle or result — short proof videos that open a WhatsApp chat convert intent into conversations.
rec.automotive.tradeoff: Message campaigns need fast replies; slow response times waste spend.
rec.realEstate.headline: Use an enquiry-focused landing page
rec.realEstate.reason: Property enquiries are higher value; a dedicated page qualifies buyers before they contact you, with policy-compliant audience targeting.
rec.realEstate.tradeoff: Adds a one-time setup cost and a few days before launch.
rec.ecommerce.headline: Get tracking ready before scaling spend
rec.ecommerce.reason: Product creatives drive discovery, but without Pixel and Conversions API you can't see which ads actually sell.
rec.ecommerce.tradeoff: One-time setup cost before results become measurable.
rec.newBusiness.headline: Run an initial test, then scale with evidence
rec.newBusiness.reason: With no historical data, a smaller first month reveals your real cost per outcome before you commit more budget.
rec.newBusiness.tradeoff: Slower initial reach while the test gathers data.
rec.tracking.headline: Protect a larger budget with proper tracking
rec.tracking.reason: At this spend level, measuring conversions lets you shift budget toward what works.
rec.bookings.headline: Give customers a simple way to book
rec.bookings.reason: Booking campaigns work best when people land on a clear page with a single action, and you can measure real bookings.
rec.bookings.tradeoff: We don't project bookings until we've seen your own conversion data.
rec.default.headline: A balanced starting plan
rec.default.reason: Your selection pairs content with distribution. Review results after the first month and adjust based on real costs per outcome.
rec.default.tradeoff: Early results reflect learning; performance usually stabilises after a few weeks.

method.title: How we calculate your estimate
method.subtitle: No black boxes. Here is every formula and assumption behind the numbers you see.
method.p1.title: Video production
method.p1.body: Number of videos × the price of your chosen tier ({quick}, {professional} or {cinematic} per video).
method.p2.title: Campaign management
method.p2.body: 15% of your monthly media spend, with a minimum of {min}. If paid ads are off, the fee is zero.
method.p3.title: Totals
method.p3.body: Monthly = videos + media spend + management. First month = monthly + one-time setup (landing page {landing}, tracking {pixel}).
method.formulas: Impressions = spend ÷ CPM × 1,000 · Reach = impressions ÷ frequency · Enquiries = spend ÷ cost per enquiry
method.provenance: These are illustrative assumptions, not verified Qatar campaign data. They will be calibrated with real first-party results.
method.fxBody: All prices are set in Qatari riyals. USD uses the Qatar Central Bank fixed parity (1 USD = 3.64 QAR); SAR uses an administrator-configured cross rate. Conversions are for reference only.
method.imageAlt: Analytics dashboard with campaign performance charts

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.q1: Is the advertising budget included in the total?
faq.a1: Yes — but it's shown separately from Fontaine's service fees. Media spend is paid to Meta; our management fee is listed on its own line.
faq.q2: Do I need to select AI videos?
faq.a2: No. A zero-video plan is completely valid — for example if you already have content and only need campaigns or a landing page.
faq.q3: Are the reach and enquiry ranges guaranteed?
faq.a3: No. They are transparent planning scenarios based on editable assumptions. Real results depend on your offer, audience, creative and platform delivery.
faq.q4: Can I request a custom website or application?
faq.a4: Yes. Custom apps and portals need a separate scope, so they are marked "price on request" rather than given a made-up number.
faq.q5: Can I use the tool in Arabic or English?
faq.a5: Yes, both languages are fully supported, and you can switch at any time without losing your selections.
faq.q6: Do I have to share my phone number to calculate?
faq.a6: No. The estimate works without any personal information. Contact details are optional and only included if you choose to send your plan.
faq.a7: No. It's an indicative estimate using our current demonstration pricing. We confirm scope, deliverables and a final quote after a short consultation.
faq.q8: Which currency will I be billed in?
faq.a8: Quotes and billing are in Qatari riyals (QAR). USD and SAR views are approximate conversions for reference.
